description: Trivial control: narrow residual to E=64 + TIED DOT-PRODUCT head (logit(v)=e_hat . emb_v, weights=tok_emb_E, learnable logit_scale). The obvious baseline skipped while chasing matmul-free heads. Same backbone as exp551 (residual->E=64, residual_tph=128) but head = dot (more expressive than Kendall rank) instead of Kendall popcount. Tests if the dot beats the rank heads at E=64. Not matmul-free (E*V matmul) but tied=0 new params, small (E=64). vs exp551 Kendall E=64 (~1.78), exp513 Linear D=384 (1.4825/1.4656).
